name: Julia
use: Voice AI that takes customer orders at White Castle drive-thrus. Named after a longtime White Castle hostess.

name: Lou AI
use: AI pizza assistant in the Papa Johns app. It builds a complete group order from everyone's preferences described in plain language.

name: DOM
use: Domino's voice ordering assistant. It takes orders in the app and over the phone and gives order status updates.

name: Archy
use: Drive-thru voice assistant that takes orders in English and Spanish. It is part of McDonald's Google-powered ArchIQ restaurant AI system, now in pilot.

name: Byte Coach
use: AI recommendation tool for restaurant managers at KFC, Pizza Hut and other Yum! brands. It tailors daily operating routines using sales forecasts and customer reviews.

name: Q-Smart
use: Hands-free AI assistant for KFC store managers in China, used through earphones and smartwatches. It helps with staff scheduling, inventory and food-quality checks.

name: AI Lucky
use: Luckin's AI ordering agent, built with Volcano Engine. It lets customers buy coffee through Qwen, WeChat and Alipay.

name: Ailo
use: Generative AI ordering agent that builds orders, applies coupons, remembers tastes and completes checkout inside WhatsApp or the iFood app.

name: Xiaomei
use: Meituan's AI agent app. Users can order food by voice, book restaurants and plan local outings.

name: Xiaotuan
use: AI assistant inside the Meituan app. It searches for merchants and deals and can place orders, call rides and book tables for the user.

name: Kangaroo Advisor
use: AI business advisor for restaurant merchants, drawing on data from about 4 million stores. It advises on store locations, new dishes and operations.

name: Xiao E
use: Voice AI assistant for delivery riders. It accepts orders, sends weather and road alerts and helps riders choose orders.

name: MAI
use: Merchant AI Assistant that acts as a virtual business advisor for restaurants and shops on Grab. It suggests menu fixes, promotions and marketing ideas.

name: The Cookbook
use: Internal AI agent that answers employee questions about ketchup production using the company's stored expertise. Built on Azure OpenAI and in pilot.

name: NesGPT
use: Nestlé's private internal generative AI assistant. Employees use it to draft emails, analyze data, summarize documents and generate ideas.

name: Andi
use: HR assistant for Coca-Cola Andina employees on WhatsApp. It answers questions about benefits and HR policies and passes harder cases to HR.

name: Olive
use: Woolworths' AI shopping assistant. It now builds weekly meal plans, finds specials and suggests cheaper swaps.

name: mycoles Assistant
use: Generative AI assistant for Coles' 115,000 staff. It answers HR questions such as leave and rostering and points staff to the right tools.

name: Ollie
use: Conversational AI that takes drive-thru orders by voice at Oliver's in Australia. It also answers questions about ingredients and allergens.

name: Al
use: Voice AI that takes Popeyes UK drive-thru orders, answers menu questions and suggests meal combinations. Named after Popeyes founder Al Copeland.

name: Clementine
use: AI shopping assistant that turns a chat, grocery list or recipe into a ready-to-buy cart from the customer's chosen store. It also generates recipes and finds deals.

name: Ask Shipt
use: AI shopping assistant that builds a grocery cart from a description, an occasion, a budget or a photo of a dish.

name: Go
use: AI shopping assistant that builds a predicted cart when the app opens. Users can also add items by voice through Grok.

name: Jasmine
use: AI phone host that answers restaurant calls. It handles questions about seating and menus and makes or changes reservations.

name: Rosie
use: AI answering service for restaurants that picks up calls 24/7. It books reservations, takes takeaway orders and answers menu questions.
